summary.detail: Rebuilt all 55 transparent runtime sprites from their locked source crops using one Sharp encode per asset, exact alpha-bound trimming, and a two-pixel transparent guard. The opaque world asset was not rebuilt. Transparent decoded pixels fell 20.84 percent.

files_changed.change: Added idempotent category-limit sizing, raw-RGB mask generation, exact alpha bounds, guarded RGBA construction, single final WebP encode, and final manifest receipts.
Restricted the isolated-process rebuild loop to the 55 transparent records and preserved the opaque world asset.
Updated width, height, bytes, pre-trim, exact-bound, guard, opaque-pixel, and alpha-coverage receipts for 55 transparent records.

tests_run.counts: 55 assets rebuilt in 55 fresh Node processes; 0 FFmpeg invocations; 0 world rebuilds

tests_run.command: inline bundled-Node Sharp manifest/file receipt audit
tests_run.counts: 56/56 dimension receipts; 56/56 byte receipts; 55/55 meaningful alpha; 55/55 two-pixel guards; 55/55 exact tight bounds; 0 failures

tests_run.command: bundled Node scripts/build-career-world-runtime-alpha.mjs --asset=ambient/cargo-boat@v1 --from-source, repeated after the full rebuild
tests_run.counts: SHA-256, byte count, and 490x257 dimensions identical before and after
ESLint executable exists under node_modules/.ignored, but eslint.config.mjs cannot resolve package eslint from the current dependency layout

claims.claim: Pre-trim dimensions are recomputed from immutable source crop dimensions and category limits, not record.output.
The output is cropped to exact non-zero alpha bounds and surrounded by a two-pixel transparent RGBA guard.
Source crop to resized raw RGB is followed by one final WebP encode; there is no intermediate source WebP.
Final dimensions, bytes, and trim receipts are written after the output file is finalized.
The wrapper uses one Node process per transparent asset and excludes world records.
Transparent decoded pixels decreased by 3,222,917, or 20.84 percent, and the opaque world hash did not change.

deviations: No separate pre-existing alpha audit script exists under scripts; the acceptance audit used Sharp directly against every manifest record.
The baseline was captured after one probe asset rebuild, so the measured 20.84 percent decoded-pixel reduction is conservative.

risks_blockers.detail: The lane-specific ESLint gate could not run because another dependency operation had moved eslint and direct dependencies under node_modules/.ignored. Syntax validation passed. The root integration gate must rerun lint after dependency restoration.

ledger_updates.requested_parent_update: Record ART-1 as complete after root integration lint/build/browser gates.
